locations.name: Apollo Aggregates Warehouse (Teddy Bear Factory)
locations.description: Cash + sellable goods, Type 9 SMG, Duke 556 assault rifle, Kalinga 50 pistol, Leroy Rook collectible card — ~$13,000 in cash/goods + card worth ~$6,000 at a pawn shop
locations.directions: Follow the highway south-east out of Hamlet to a gravel industrial yard near three large rectangular pools. Look for the red warehouse with teddy-bear delivery trucks. Check the yellow toolbox outside first, then search the bodies, offices, safes and rear shutter inside. Goods must be sold at a fence (e.g. Brian's Lockup) — the headline figure is not all banked cash.
locations.source: Jabba Reviews + GTAVibes — via Johnny's original GTA 6 Map catalog (poster-area pin, grid: SE of Hamlet)

locations.directions: In Key Lento, find the Nifty Threads shirt icon on your map, then the fenced grey Badger R&D tower just north-west of it, between the road and the waterfront.
